name: Sade Sati
trigger: When Saturn transits the 12th, 1st, and 2nd house from the Moon sign.
interpretation: Period of intense struggle, financial loss, and health issues to mother. Requires immense patience and Hanuman worship.

name: Kantaka Shani
trigger: When Saturn transits the 4th, 8th, or 10th house from the Moon sign.
interpretation: A thorn in the leg. Causes domestic unhappiness (4th), chronic health issues (8th), and career setbacks (10th).
